content.short: A comprehensive Mantle-based trading platform featuring a self-custodial wallet, perpetuals, and a token launchpad.
content.description:
Funny Money is a versatile DeFi platform on the Mantle Network that simplifies the trading experience. It offers a self-custodial wallet integrated with a native perpetual futures exchange, allowing for secure and efficient leverage trading. The platform also features a token launchpad, providing a curated space for new projects to debut and for the community to discover early-stage opportunities.

Leveraging Mantle's high throughput and low fees, Funny Money delivers a responsive trading environment without compromising on decentralization. Through its diverse suite of tools, the protocol empowers users to manage portfolios and participate in DeFi innovation.
content.meta: Trade perpetuals and discover new tokens with Funny Money on Mantle. A secure, self-custodial trading hub and launchpad for the Web3 era.
